role: OWNER_APPROVED_CENTRAL_SCENARIO: policy-central (bridge v1.1) is the dashboard default; uniform low/medium/high atlas bundles are comparators.

conditional_band.definition_source: conditional_bands_v2/BAND_REGISTRY_V2.md (estimand and boundary quoted verbatim from §1 and §6)
conditional_band.estimand: exact per-state conditional prediction band — registered load-model parameter uncertainty propagated per state, conditional on the policy-central pathway; author-model band, not frequentist coverage.
conditional_band.boundary: Author-model conditional band: registered evidence-bounded parameter distributions through the author's load model, conditional on the registered policy-central pathway. Not a frequentist prediction interval; no repeated-sampling coverage. Outside the band by construction: pathway/policy choice (bridge classes, scenarios), L1 state-condition uncertainty (fixed at central here; <=2.75% marginal, see Section 3), structural model error, and the fixed vehicle/STI inventory scope.
conditional_band.layer: pure L2 exact per-state propagation (L1 fixed at central), p05/p95 of 200 raw draws, seed 42, no recentering, no envelope transfer
conditional_band.v1_transfer_rule_retired_from_display: conditional_bands_v1's CA/OH mean-relative-envelope transfer and its DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY intensity carve-out are retired from display and from all numeric claims; the v1 files are packaged unchanged for audit only
conditional_band.anchor_backtest_note: v2-vs-v1 anchor raw gate worst 4.65pp is the documented cumulative-L1+L2 vs pure-L2 estimand difference; like-for-like pure-L2 agreement is <=1.01pp (BAND_REGISTRY_V2.md §3)

conditional_band_v1_audit.estimand: a conditional prediction band — author-model load uncertainty (per-vehicle compute/sensing/communication lognormal scales, efficiency-path and conversion-efficiency parameters) combined with state-condition uncertainty (grid fossil factor, weather, initialization shares), conditional on the registered deployment and trajectory pathway.
conditional_band_v1_audit.boundary: It quantifies how far the outcome could plausibly sit from the central estimate if the registered pathway is realized; it is not a frequentist coverage interval, and no repeated-sampling coverage claim is attached to the 5-95 range. Pathway (L3) uncertainty is communicated separately by discrete scenario trajectories, not by this band.
conditional_band_v1_audit.layer: L2 cumulative (L1 + L2 active), p05/p95 of 200 raw draws, no recentering

weather_variant.interpretation: named deterministic variant, never a probability band

boundary_strings_stamped_from_atlas.grid_boundary: eGRID2023 state generation attributional direct CO2; not delivered-electricity mix, marginal emissions, or a forecast
boundary_strings_stamped_from_atlas.carrier_input_estimand: annual operational ATS-incremental carrier input for the normalized reference bundle; propulsion and conventional signal-core energy excluded
boundary_strings_stamped_from_atlas.direct_co2_estimand: scope-matched operational direct CO2: eGRID state total-output attributional electricity CO2 plus EPA gasoline tailpipe CO2; upstream, non-CO2 and embodied terms excluded
boundary_strings_stamped_from_atlas.claim_boundary: deterministic comparative scenarios, not empirical forecasts, causal policy effects, city or urban-rural estimands, carbon-neutrality dates, or cumulative payback dates

claim_boundary: Policy-conditioned deterministic scenarios for normalized synthetic reference bundles; not empirical forecasts, probability intervals, causal policy effects, actual state totals, carbon-neutrality dates, or cumulative payback dates.
